dataset_name: Sub-divisional Monthly Rainfall Data for India (1901–2017)
source_organization: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India
preprocessing_steps: 1. Extracted sub-divisional monthly records for North-East Indian meteorological zones (1901-2017).
2. Validated column structure (SUBDIVISION, YEAR, JAN..DEC, ANNUAL, Jan-Feb, Mar-May, Jun-Sep, Oct-Dec).
3. Handled missing/NA numeric fields using 117-year sub-divisional monthly mean interpolation.
4. Normalized subdivision strings and mapped to standard NER logistics hubs (Guwahati, Shillong, Silchar, Agartala, Imphal, Aizawl, Kohima, Gangtok, Itanagar).
5. Computed 117-year baseline monthly means, monsoon totals (Jun-Sep), seasonal percentages, and multi-decade annual trends.
6. Generated normalized monthly historical environmental risk index scores (0.0 to 1.0) for route planner and GIS map overlays.
disclaimer: HISTORICAL RAINFALL — NOT LIVE WEATHER. Represents multi-decade statistical rainfall baselines (1901–2017) compiled from official IMD records. This dataset powers historical risk weighting and trend analysis; it does NOT represent live or current weather measurements.
